question: Should threaded completion delivery require observed account and thread evidence to match exactly, while retaining the branch’s limited generated-media omitted-account compatibility rule?
rationale: This is a user-visible delivery-policy choice: stricter accounting prevents false success for another route, but can make integrations with incomplete delivery metadata take fallback or failure paths.

options.title: Adopt target-aware accounting
options.body: Merge the exact route-evidence policy and keep the narrow generated-media compatibility exception, with the current regressions as the permanent contract.

options.title: Keep broad sent evidence
options.body: Reject this behavior change and continue counting generic sent/message-tool evidence as visible delivery when route metadata is incomplete.

options.title: Narrow the exception first
options.body: Ask for a smaller policy that keeps account matching strict everywhere and moves any generated-media relaxation into a separately approved compatibility path.

recommendation.title: Adopt target-aware accounting
recommendation.body: Merge the exact route-evidence policy and keep the narrow generated-media compatibility exception, with the current regressions as the permanent contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their previously merged ACP bound-thread delivery work and this branch provide the closest feature-history context for the delivery-policy decision.
